final: {"number": 718, "label": "question", "route": "answer", "related": [1417, 1389], "evidence": ["mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/Mockito.java"], "reply": "Mockito can only stub method calls. when(...) and doReturn(...).when(...) need a method invoked on the mock (see Mockito.when and Mockito.doReturn in Mockito.java), so a field like Build.VERSION.SDK_INT cannot be stubbed. SDK_INT is a static final constant that the compiler inlines, so mocking Build.VERSION does not change it either. The usual fix is to move the read behind a method you own: create an interface with an int sdkInt() method, whose real implementation returns Build.VERSION.SDK_INT. Inject that interface into the code under test, then stub it in the test with when(provider.sdkInt()).thenReturn(16). The Javadoc in Mockito.java covers when and doReturn."}
